# Model fixtures

`report-example.json` preserves the report pp.15–18 smaller Source/Review/CI/Decision/Sink example, including exponential mean=16 and empirical logical reference. It is not the full Test/Deploy acceptance template, and has no actual dataset binding.

`default-delivery.json` is a PROPOSED D-017 complete synthetic template. Added test/deploy durations, explicit failure/rework instrumentation and continuous-day mean=48 are assumptions, not extracted customer data.

Queue fixtures have hand-computable expectations in ../simulation/expected-cases.json. No Go engine result digest has been invented.
